title: Wednesday, no summit: what happened overnight, and the one thing that is stuck
when: 11 November 2026, 07:25 UTC (scheduled wake; since brief 22, 18:45 UTC on 10 November)
headline: Web Summit called off today because of Storm Charles; Thursday goes ahead. Overnight the PrompTugal app got its last two rounds and all five builds are with Apple. The Team app's overnight work is written but stuck: its chat needs your yes to push. Nothing is decided here.

stats.label: PrompTugal app builds with Apple's review (556 to 587)
tap now to pick a talk and add it to your calendar (was 3)
Team app changes on TestFlight yet: waiting for your yes
our stand day, between Booths A1-30

for_you.ask: Unblock the Team app helper (1 minute)
for_you.detail: Open the chat '2 · teamapp' and reply: 'Yes, attach the repositories and push'. Tap Allow if asked. Its work (light mode, ticked-off tasks, Where details, Plan with pills, no app-switcher cover, one-tap messaging) then goes to TestFlight in about an hour.
for_you.recommend: Now, so the Team app is ready for Thursday.

for_you.detail: Still waiting from yesterday: a new Claude Code session you start yourself, with the inbox prompt from your kit. Tell me and I add the schedule.
for_you.recommend: Today, while there is no summit.

for_you.ask: Use the free day to rehearse the stand demo
for_you.detail: Three made-up visitors through the demo helper and Angelo's side-by-side runner, with a recorded backup. Thursday is the only summit day left.
for_you.recommend: This morning, with Angelo, before the red wind warning from midday.

you_asked.said: Team app: light mode, ticked-off tasks, Where details, Plan with all events and pills, no recent-apps cover, messaging
you_asked.done: Written by the overnight helper in its chat; not pushed, because the chat refused to push without your yes.

you_asked.said: The storm note in the app
you_asked.done: In build 587: a notice on Now from promptugal.news, and Wednesday's sessions left out. The newsroom can change it with no app release.
Six rounds, five builds with Apple. Light mode by default, articles in the app, interviews with transcripts, one tap to pick a talk.

sections.title: 1. Overnight
items: Web Summit confirmed: 'Day 2 (Wednesday, November 11th) will not take place'; Thursday 12 November as planned (websummit.com, read 22:25 UTC).
PrompTugal app build 587: light mode, articles drawn in the app, interviews with Article and Transcript pills, the storm notice. Submitted to Apple and in the external group at 00:20 UTC.
Taps saved: open a talk from Now, 1 (was not possible); pick a talk and add to calendar, 1 (was 3); open the venue map, 1 (was 3 and a scroll).
Your new video editor helper did its first interview's colour and sound pass.
Your accounts inbox: one report filed.

sections.title: 2. Stuck
items: The Team app helper stopped at 22:27 UTC waiting for your yes to push. Its changes exist only in its chat's copy of the code.
The newsroom helper's site redesign brief still waits for PrompTugal's team (or Dinis) to say yes.

next: Today: no summit; Storm Charles, red wind warning from midday to 21:00, red rain warning 12:00 to 18:00. Follow IPMA and civil protection.
